title: Update a negative keyword
content_data:
Use this endpoint to update a negative keyword for Search Ads. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/update/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | object_type {Required} | string | Object type. Use this field to specify whether you want to update the negative keywords for a campaign or ad group.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: campaign.
  • `ADGROUP`: ad group.
| | object_id {Required} | string | Object ID. Object ID. Use this field to pass in a campaign ID or ad group ID that you want to update the negative keyword for.

Specify this field according to `object_type`:
  • If `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, assign to this field a campaign ID.
  • If `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, assign to this field an ad group ID.
| | old_keyword_id {Required} | string | The ID of the negative keyword that you want to update.

To obtain the ID of a negative keyword, use [/search_ad/negative_word/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1775104887052289).

Note: If the negative keyword ID that you specify does not exist, an error will occur. | | keyword {Required} | object| Information about the update to the original keyword. | #| name {Required} | string | The new name for the negative keyword you specify via `old_keyword_id`.

Length limit: no more than 80 characters.

The name needs to exclude the following special characters: [`!`, `@`, `%`, `^` , `(` , `)` , `=`, `{`, `}`, `;`, `~` , ``` , `<` , `>` , `?`, `\` , `|`]. Otherwise, an error will occur.

Note: Duplicate negative keyword names will be de-duplicated to only one unique name, and for each unique name you can only specify one match type.
However, if you want to update the match type of a negative keyword, you can pass in the same name via `name` and assign a different match type via `match_type`. | #| match_type | string | Match type for the negative keyword.

Enum values:

  • `PRECISE_WORD`: exact match.
  • `PHRASE_WORD`: phrase match.
  • `BROAD_WORD`: broad match.
Default value: `BROAD_WORD`.| ``` ### Example - Update the name of a negative keyword ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id":"{{advertiser_id}}", "object_type":"CAMPAIGN", "object_id":"{{object_id}}", "old_keyword_id":"{{old_keyword_id}}", "keyword":{ "name":"{{name}}" } }' (/code) ``` ### Example - Update the match type of a negative keyword ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id":"{{advertiser_id}}", "object_type":"CAMPAIGN", "object_id":"{{object_id}}", "old_keyword_id":"{{old_keyword_id}}", "keyword":{ "name":"{{name}}", "match_type":"PRECISE_WORD" } }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| new_keyword_id | string | ID of the updated negative keyword. | ``` ### Example - Update the name of a negative keyword ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{}}", "data": { "new_keyword_id": "{{new_keyword_id}}" } } (/code) ``` ### Example - Update the match type of a negative keyword ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{}}", "data": { "new_keyword_id": "{{old_keyword_id}}" } } (/code) ```
